scope.task: Classify all six P0 findings in the independent operation audit against the candidate execution semantics and the self-sealed SYS Listening authority.

safetyBoundary.decision: A validator finding may be cleared only by preserving or strengthening the sealed authority. Adding fields, lookups, callbacks, events, or outbox delivery merely to satisfy a string-matching validator is prohibited.

callerAuth.signature: active issuer/source-stream key; exact audience and digest

protectedSubmitAtomicOrder: APPEND anonymous response with per-response key

validatorRootCauses.description: selector_findings indexes selectors only by exact selector.source and requires an exact string match with the parent request-field source. It does not recognize closed signed artifacts whose executable selectors consume nested signed claims.
selector_findings does not recognize a composite path-to-signed-claim-to-locked-row equality proof even when the input effect and locked admission selector require that equality fail-closed.
listening_authority_findings hardcodes stale body fields participationEnvelope and formRevision instead of reading the self-sealed v2 authority request schema.
The audit correction text incorrectly asks for an outbox on protected submit, while the authority explicitly requires owner-local private receipt delivery and forbids broker outbox publication.

findingClassifications.subject: modern.listening.active.query headers.X-Listening-Participation-Credential
findingClassifications.reason: The credential is a closed signed artifact, not a database public-ID selector. The authority defines SIGNED_PARTICIPATION_CREDENTIAL caller authentication. The candidate consumes credential.admissionPublicId through a tenant-bound latest-stable admission selector and credential.aud through OWNER_PORT::DWP.Listening.ProtectedResourceAudienceVerifier, with active issuer-key, time-window, audience, offline non-revocation, exact form/admission, and fail-closed rules. The validator sees neither selector because both sources are nested under the parent credential source.

acceptableCorrection.preferred: Represent the parent field as a typed SIGNED_CREDENTIAL verification contract, or add a resolution discriminator, and make the validator require the matching callerAuth plus the closed value schema, nested admission selector, nested audience cryptographic verifier, time/non-revocation checks, and fail-closed behavior.
forbidden: inventing a credential database table
persisting or logging the compact credential
issuer callback from the anonymous protected endpoint
accepting prose or a substring without structured nested selectors

findingClassifications.subject: modern.listening.response.submit body.signedParticipationCredential
findingClassifications.reason: The submit credential has a closed schema and an OFFLINE_SIGNED_CREDENTIAL_AND_NONREVOCATION_PROOF input effect. Its nested admission claim selects and locks the exact owner-local admission tip; its nested audience claim invokes the typed protected-resource verifier. The authority calls this the caller-auth mechanism and never defines it as a database row reference. Exact parent-source matching therefore produces a false P0.

acceptableCorrection.preferred: Use the same typed signed-credential verification-contract rule as active.query, additionally requiring zero mutation for invalid signature, algorithm, key, audience, time, proof, tenant, survey, admission, form, consent, or token-commitment mismatch.
forbidden: removing signature or non-revocation checks
changing anonymous callerAuth to authenticated principal
turning the credential into a durable local identity row
accepting a selector that validates only aud but not the complete signed artifact

findingClassifications.subject: modern.listening.response.submit pathParameters.surveyId
findingClassifications.reason: The route value is intentionally not an independent foreign lookup. Its reference resolution is PROTECTED_LOCAL_SIGNED_ADMISSION_CLAIM_EQUALITY_ONLY; the input effect requires SIGNED_CLAIM_EQUALITY_ONLY; and the locked admission selector requires path survey = credential survey = target survey with zero mutation on mismatch. The validator only performs exact source-string matching and ignores that composite equality proof.

acceptableCorrection.preferred: Either teach the validator to accept this exact structured composite proof, or materialize an explicit PROTECTED_LOCAL_ROUTE_SURVEY_EQUALITY selector sourced from pathParameters.surveyId and targeting the already locked admission survey_public_id with complete tenant, purpose, version/as-of, causal equality, cardinality, and fail-closed fields.
forbidden: a second cross-owner survey lookup
accepting path-to-credential equality without equality to the locked admission row
latest fallback or non-tenant-bound comparison

findingClassifications.subject: modern.listening.response.submit formRevision and participationEnvelope
findingClassifications.reason: The self-sealed v2 authority requires signedParticipationCredential, surveyId, responseToken, and answers. It does not require a second participationEnvelope or a client formRevision. The signed credential pins formVersionPublicId and formArtifactDigest; the locked admission supplies form_revision and the authoritative typed question set. The candidate already performs the seven owner-local receipt, admission lock, token, response, answer, bind, and private-receipt-close steps. The authority explicitly sets outboxTable to null and BROKER_OUTBOX_FORBIDDEN.

acceptableCorrection.preferred: Derive validator requirements from the pinned self-sealed authority. Require the four authority inputs, exact credential/locked-admission form binding, all seven atomic stages, private receipt replay/erasure behavior, and no broker outbox.
acceptableCorrection.authoritySuccessorException: A second protected-owner envelope is acceptable only through an explicitly versioned and independently reviewed authority successor that defines its producer, delivery through active query, signature key ownership, expiry/revocation, credential/token/form binding, replay behavior, and privacy boundary. It cannot be invented only to clear this audit.
forbidden: trusting a standalone client formRevision
requiring a second envelope with no authoritative producer lifecycle
adding protected response or answer publication to an outbox
emitting raw response, answer, token, credential, principal, worker, IP, session, or issuer-trace data

findingClassifications.subject: modern.learning.completion.verify body.skillEvidenceIds
findingClassifications.reason: The child row stores skill_evidence_public_id from ownerProof.body.evidencePublicId.skillEvidenceIds[*] but resolves worker_skill_evidence_id from undeclared body.skillEvidenceIds[*]. The body field is absent from requestFields and inputEffects, and the two identity sources can diverge. This is an executable ghost input and an integrity gap.

acceptableCorrection.preferred: Remove the ghost body source. Derive the ordered public-ID set exclusively from the immutable, exact-version owner proof; batch-select every corresponding prf_skl_worker_evidence row by same tenant, authorized purpose/population, expected worker/assignment relationship, and exact as-of/version; require set equality, uniqueness, stable ordering, and exactly one local row per proof ID before appending child references.
acceptableCorrection.lessPreferred: A declared client field is acceptable only if it is closed typed and its ordered set is proven exactly equal to the immutable owner-proof set before any write. It must never override the owner proof.
forbidden: silently accepting extra, missing, duplicate, cross-tenant, wrong-worker, stale, or revoked skill-evidence IDs
using client IDs as authority without equality to the owner proof
partial child insertion

findingClassifications.subject: internal.workforceplan.simulation-result.consume WorkforceScenarioSimulated.v2
findingClassifications.reason: The handler performs its terminal CAS on ppl_wfp_simulation_requests and the event aggregateEntityType and refetch entity are both that simulation-request table. modern.workforceplan.scenario.query accepts a scenario identity and returns a scenario projection; merely joining simulation requests cannot re-enter the emitted aggregate identity or exact event revision. The correct aggregate is the simulation request, not the scenario.

acceptableCorrection.preferred: Set refetch mode to FORBIDDEN for both success and failure events, remove endpointOperationId/entity/version/as-of refetch hints, and declare PAYLOAD_SUFFICIENT_NOTIFICATION_ONLY, NO_LATEST_FALLBACK, and AGGREGATE_LOOKUP_FORBIDDEN. The current internal HRIS-HRM-only payload already carries simulationRequestId/revision, scenarioId, state transition, aggregateVersion, occurredAt, correlationId, and exact result receipt revision/schema/digest. Consumers must use a separately authorized SimulationResultReceipt/artifact owner contract for result content, with exact receipt revision/schema/digest and deny-on-unavailable; the event remains a minimized notification and proof pointer.
acceptableCorrection.productRequirementAlternative: Only if a real consumer requirement for aggregate detail re-entry is documented, add modern.workforceplan.simulation.query with simulationRequestId as a typed path selector, optional parent scenario equality, response entity table:ppl_wfp_simulation_requests, event.simulationRequestRevision exact with no latest fallback, event.occurredAt as-of, same-tenant PEP, and the exact event field allowlist. Accept the resulting operation/query count and all manifest/downstream count cascades; do not preserve 199/66 artificially.
forbidden: changing the event aggregate to scenario without a scenario-root state mutation and version append
treating a joined child table as exact identity re-entry
latest-version fallback
omitting tenant, purpose, consumer, field, revision, or as-of enforcement

signedCredentialVerifier: reject missing or altered signature, kid, alg, audience, iat, nbf, exp, or non-revocation proof
reject inactive or unknown issuer key and expired or future proof
reject credential tenant, survey, admission, admission version, form, consent, or token commitment mismatch
reject worker, person, principal, employee, session, IP, user-agent, or issuer-trace claims in the protected anonymous boundary
reject a mere prose marker or target-name substring when structured callerAuth and nested selectors are absent
reject persistence or logging of raw credential or raw response token
routeSurveyBinding: reject route survey != signed credential survey
reject signed credential survey != locked admission survey
reject cross-tenant, stale admission tip, closed window, or inactive admission
prove the equality uses the same locked admission row and does not perform a foreign-owner repository read
protectedSubmitAuthority: reject missing credential, token, answers, or route survey
reject answers not in the locked form key/type/cardinality/choice vocabulary
reject standalone client formRevision as authority
reject any broker/public outbox for response, answer, token, or credential facts
concurrent submit versus close uses the same admission lock fence
same token and same digest returns the sealed private result with zero writes
same token and different digest conflicts with zero mutation
replay after erasure returns only the non-linkable tombstone without a comparison oracle
fault injection at each of the seven stages rolls back every stage
learningCompletionEvidence: reject any set mismatch between owner proof and local selected skill evidence
reject duplicates, missing rows, extra rows, cross-tenant rows, wrong-worker rows, stale rows, revoked rows, and unstable ordering
fault injection prevents partial child append
workforceSimulationRefetch: reject scenario query as refetch for a simulation-request aggregate
when refetch is FORBIDDEN, reject any endpointOperationId, entity, revision, as-of, latest-fallback, or aggregate-query hint and require payload-sufficient notification-only semantics
require result content access through an independently authorized exact SimulationResultReceipt/artifact owner contract; deny on unavailable and never fall back to scenario projection
reject wrong simulationRequestId, parent scenario, tenant, revision, as-of, purpose, consumer, or field allowlist
apply the same exact detail-query or explicit FORBIDDEN rule to success and failure events

concurrentSourceObservation.disposition: Any unreviewed working-source attempt that adds participationEnvelope or formRevision is outside the self-sealed authority and must not be accepted merely because it clears the stale validator. It requires either removal or a separately versioned authority-successor review with a complete producer lifecycle.

requiredCloseoutOrder: Correct the two true-positive source semantics without weakening owner proof, tenancy, as-of, or atomicity.
Correct the validator to model typed signed-artifact verification and composite locked equality, and to read the self-sealed Listening request and outbox policy instead of stale hardcoded fields.
Add all hostile regressions listed in this report and prove they fail closed.
Generate a new distinct candidate from reviewed source; never mutate or promote uaHfXj in place.
Run independent operation, route, owner-boundary, physical, PostgreSQL 16/18, and downstream lineage gates on the same reviewed bytes.
Keep Gate closed until all authoritative gates pass.
residualBlockers: Learning completion ghost source remains a P0 in candidate uaHfXj.
Workforce simulation-result event refetch remains a P0 in candidate uaHfXj.
The current independent validator is not safe to use as a zero-finding acceptance authority until the four false-positive rules and hostile tests are corrected.
Any unreviewed generator change that introduces a second envelope or client form revision remains outside authority.
